 
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "PublicReadGetObject",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::no-name-games.com/*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "S3Actions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:GetObjectTagging",
        "s3:GetBucketLifecycle",
        "s3:GetBucketLocation",
        "s3:GetBucketAcl",
        "s3:PutObjectAcl",
        "s3:RestoreObject",
        "s3:DeleteBucketCors",
        "s3:DeleteBucketPolicy",
        "s3:ListBucket",
        "s3:ListBucketVersions",
        "s3:ListObjects",
        "s3:ListObjectsV2",
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:PutObjectAcl",
        "s3:PutObjectTagging",
        "s3:UploadPart",
        "s3:UploadPartCopy",
        "s3:CompleteMultipartUpload",
        "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::no-name-games.com/*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "EC2Actions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "ec2:DescribeInstances"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "KMSActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey",
        "kms:Revoke",
        "kms:Sign",
        "kms:Verify",
        "kms:CreateAlias",
        "kms:DeleteAlias",
        "kms:ImportKey",
        "kms:ListAliases",
        "kms:ListKeys",
        "kms:UpdateKeyMetadata"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IAMActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "iam:AttachRolePolicy",
        "iam:AttachUserPolicy",
        "iam:DetachRolePolicy",
        "iam:DetachUserPolicy",
        "iam:CreateUser",
        "iam:CreateGroup",
        "iam:CreateRole",
        "iam:DeleteUser",
        "iam:DeleteGroup",
        "iam:DeleteRole",
        "iam:AddUserToGroup",
        "iam:RemoveUserFromGroup",
        "iam:AddUserToRole",
        "iam:RemoveUserFromRole",
        "iam:CreatePolicy",
        "iam:DeletePolicy",
        "iam:AttachPolicy",
        "iam:DetachPolicy",
        "iam:CreatePolicyDocument",
        "iam:DeletePolicyDocument",
        "iam:UpdatePolicyDocument"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "CloudTrailActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "cloudtrail:CreateTrail",
        "cloudtrail:DeleteTrail",
        "cloudtrail:DescribeTrails",
        "cloudtrail:EnableLogging",
        "cloudtrail:DisableLogging",
        "cloudtrail:UpdateTrailStatus"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "GuardDutyActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "guardduty:GetIPSet",
        "guardduty:CreateIPSet",
        "guardduty:UpdateIPSet",
        "guardduty:DeleteIPSet"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "SNSActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "sns:Publish",
        "sns:Subscribe",
        "sns:Unsubscribe"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "SQSActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "sqs:CreateQueue",
        "sqs:DeleteQueue",
        "sqs:ChangeQueueAttributes",
        "sqs:ReceiveMessage",
        "sqs:SendMessage",
        "sqs:DeleteMessage",
        "sqs:DeleteQueue",
        "sqs:ListQueues",
        "sqs:ListQueueTags"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "SESActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "ses:SendRawEmail",
        "ses:SendBulkEmail",
        "ses:SendEmail",
        "ses:DeleteSentEmail",
        "ses:GetSendQuota",
        "ses:GetSendStatistics",
        "ses:GetSendStatisticsForSendTimeRange",
        "ses:GetSendStatisticsForViewableAddresses",
        "ses:ListSendQuotas",
        "ses:ListSendStatistics",
        "ses:ListSendStatisticsForSendTimeRange",
        "ses:ListSendStatisticsForViewableAddresses"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "SageMakerActions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": [
        "sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstance",
        "sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob",
        "sagemaker:CreateModel",
        "sagemaker:CreateExperiment",
        "sagemaker:CreateEndpoint",
        "sagemaker:CreateDomain",
        "sagemaker:CreateImage",
        "sagemaker:CreatePipeline",
        "sagemaker:CreateProject",
        "sagemaker:CreateRepository",
        "sagemaker:CreateRole",
        "sagemaker:CreateSession",
        "sagemaker:CreateStudio",
        "sagemaker:CreateTrainingJobRun",

        "sagemaker:DeleteExperiment",

        "sagemaker:DeleteSession",
        "sagemaker:DeleteStudio",
        "sagemaker:DeleteTrainingJob",

        "sagemaker:DescribeImage",
        "sagemaker:DescribeModel",
        "sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage",
        "sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageVersion",
        "sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstance",

        "sagemaker:DescribeRole",
        "sagemaker:DescribeSession",
        "sagemaker:DescribeStudio",
        "sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob",
        "sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJobRun",
        "sagemaker:GetHyperParameterTuningJob",
        "sagemaker:GetModel",
        "sagemaker:GetModelPackage",
        "sagemaker:GetModelPackageVersion",
        "sagemaker:GetNotebookInstance",
        "sagemaker:GetPipeline",
        "sagemaker:GetProject",
        "sagemaker:GetRepository",
        "sagemaker:GetRole",
        "sagemaker:GetSession",
        "sagemaker:GetStudio",
        "sagemaker:GetTrainingJob",
        "sagemaker:GetTrainingJobRun",
        "sagemmaker:GetHyperParameterTuningJob"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
